buildCommand: cd ../.. && pnpm --filter @edify/shared build && cd apps/web && npx next build

crons._comment: Sprint A.5: document extraction sweeper. Runs once daily at UTC midnight. Originally specced at 3h but Vercel Hobby tier rejects sub-daily crons (CLI deploy surfaced this; reference_vercel_hobby_cron_tier_limit.md). Tradeoff: extraction retries span 3 days instead of 9h; fresh-user case unaffected (wizard-completion sync trigger handles first-run). Revisit if/when upgrading to Pro.
